rows.text: You are taking a stroll in the city of St. Domingo... Dazzling lights are everywhere. As you are mesmerized by the brilliance, someone taps on your right shoulder. You turn around in surprise, and your left arm is clasped the next second.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Hello." A St. Domingo mechacop bows to you and says, "Please come with me. Evidence: Your previous usage of cheat codes have been documented."
